infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RoadWise uses your location to read your speed, look up speed limits and measure distance while you drive.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Background location lets your family group see where you are between drives. Only used if you join a group.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location lets your family group see where you are between drives. Only used if you join a group.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Optional driver monitoring uses the front camera to detect eyes off the road and drowsiness. Frames are processed on your phone and never uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs photo library access to let you pick a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This identifier will be used to deliver personalized rewards and improve the experience.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app may use your microphone for voice-driven safety features.
